rules.check: ik.target is not a descendant of any constrained bone
when IK controls two bones, the second bone is the immediate child of the first
hand, strap and prop targets are not shared unless explicitly declared
constraint order changes have an artifact reference and expected affected set
editor export and runtime major.minor versions match
vertex influence count and tiny weights stay within calibrated budget
rest, contact, return, mirrored and unreachable-target poses are rendered
every semantic action can be interrupted and returns to idle
